description: This file contains internal hash functions, classes, and traits for the Abseil C++ library, specifically related to hashing mechanisms and hash state management.

classes.name: HashState
classes.description: Represents an intermediate state in hash computation.

classes.name: HashStateBase
classes.description: CRTP base class providing common hash state operations.

classes.name: PiecewiseCombiner
classes.description: Helper class for hashing buffers in chunks.

classes.name: MixingHashState
classes.description: Hash state implementation optimized for mixing and combining hash values.

methods.name: PiecewiseCombiner::add_buffer
methods.description: Adds a buffer segment to the hash sequence.

methods.name: PiecewiseCombiner::finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation for buffered data.

methods.name: HashStateBase::combine
methods.description: Combines multiple values into the hash state.

methods.name: HashStateBase::combine_contiguous
methods.description: Combines a contiguous array of elements into the hash state.

methods.name: HashStateBase::combine_unordered
methods.description: Combines elements in an unordered manner into the hash state.

methods.name: MixingHashState::hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a given input, optimized for integral types.
